nodes.title: Resolution at the first nonzero cohomology degree
nodes.statement: Let P be a finite projective cochain complex supported in [a,b], with first nonzero cohomology degree m. For K=coker(d^{m−1}:P^{m−1}→P^m), the truncated sequence 0→P^a→…→P^m→K→0 is a finite projective resolution; pd_R K≤m−a.
hypotheses: Rings are commutative with identity; cochain degrees and Euler signs are integral. All stated finiteness and nonvanishing hypotheses are required.
proofSteps: Vanishing of cohomology below m is precisely exactness at each preceding term. Reverse the cochain indexing to get a projective resolution of K of length m−a.
acceptance: Acyclic P is excluded because m would not exist.

nodes.title: Support through a nilpotent action quotient
nodes.statement: Let C,T be as in action-subalgebra-support, I⊆T nilpotent, and R→T/I a surjection.
